name: Book Launch: The South Bank
content: Come along to the book launch of The South Bank: 75 Years of Regeneration **Please note you will need to book a ticket for this event on Eventbrite. If you're viewing this page on the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre website, scroll to the bottom to book.** This book launch and presentation of Tony Bates’ The South Bank: 75 Years of Regeneration will explore the transformation and cultural revolution of the South Bank over the last seventy five years. Tony will discuss the changing appreciation of the local architecture, alongside the societal changes that have culminated in the opening of the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre. Copies of The South Bank: 75 Years of Regeneration will be available to purchase on the evening, with a 20% discount. ****About the author**** Tony Bates (he/she) has a background in engineering and architecture, and has a longstanding love of photography. He is an award winning and published photographer. For the last two years Tony has been working on this project about the South Bank, and has managed to get the book placed in several bookshops on the South Bank. This project encompasses all of Tony's passions; politics, history, photography, architecture, people, and the LGBTQ+ community. ****Accessibility at the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre**** The Centre's accessibility statement is [here][1]. ****Covid safety at the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre**** To keep our community safe, we ask that all visitors do not visit the centre if they are feeling any Covid-19 symptoms including headache, fever, sore throat, consistent cough or chills. You can wear a mask if you feel more comfortable. We also have masks and hand sanitiser available at the Centre. For current information on [Covid][2] please visit the NHS website. ****Donate to the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre**** We rely on donations to ensure that the London LGBTQ+ Community Centre can keep its doors open for years to come. To donate or become a Friend of the Centre, visit our [website][3].
